resources.string: This accessibility service allows the app to perform assisted touch gestures on behalf of the user to reduce repetitive actions. It only operates when explicitly activated by the user and does not collect or transmit any personal or sensitive data.

To get started, please grant the app the necessary permissions and read the safety notices.

These permissions are required for the app to function properly. They are only used for the purposes described below and nothing else.
Notifications are needed to inform you if the app is running in the background.
Allows the app to display its user interface on top of other apps.
This is used to simulate tap input as well as drag gestures on the touchscreen of your device.
Please also read the following security notices before using the app
Touch gestures are executed at the system level. This may trigger system navigation actions (such as Back, Home, or app switching) or interact with other apps while gestures are running.
Once a gesture has started, it cannot be stopped or canceled. The action will continue until it finishes, even if you leave the app or interact with the screen.
Automated gestures may interact with other apps on your device. This can trigger actions outside this app and may have unintended consequences.
